This misstep occurred due to a misinterpretation of the label affiliations, as *MBDTF* was indeed released under Roc-A-Fella Records (in conjunction with Def Jam), making it the correct answer. 

The Planner incorrectly revised the conclusion based on incomplete or misunderstood context, leading to a task resolution inconsistent with the verified data gathered earlier.
